name: qdrant-model-migration
prompt: We have a production collection with 180M vectors from OpenAI `text-embedding-ada-002` and want to move to `text-embedding-3-large` while keeping search online. The new vectors have different dimensions, and we'd like to A/B test quality before cutting over. What migration plan should we use?

rubric.text: Confirms the model change requires full re-embedding into a NEW vector space (ada-002 1536-d and 3-large 3072-d are incompatible; old vectors can't be reused or mixed)

Supports the requested A/B test using either separate collections or separate named vectors, pairing each query embedding model with its matching collection or vector field to compare quality before committing

If recommending an in-place named-vector addition, checks that the server is v1.18+ and the collection already uses named vectors. A separate-collection migration satisfies this criterion without discussing the in-place alternative

Validates backfill completeness and retrieval quality before cutover; coordinates the query embedding model with using for an in-place migration, or with the collection/alias switch for a new collection
Enables writes of both embeddings before backfill and handles failed writes so incoming documents reach both vector spaces

Respects the inability to pause writes by requiring additional synchronization, such as ordered change replay with a cutover barrier or version/tombstone-aware reconciliation; explains that dual writes or insert_only alone do not prevent stale embeddings or deleted-point resurrection
Keeps old embeddings and dual writes through a rollback observation period, retiring them only after readers have switched and rollback is no longer required

Addresses bulk throughput using batched re-embedding; if suggesting a higher indexing_threshold, scopes it to a destination not serving queries, restores the original value, and waits for indexing before cutover
Explains that aliases redirect requests but do not copy payloads or choose a named vector
Recommends update_mode: insert, or uses insert_only to backfill a missing named vector on points that already exist
Suggests reusing or mixing the old ada-002 vectors with the new ones, or that re-embedding can be skipped here
Assumes a named vector can be added to an existing collection without checking server version (fails on v1.17 or earlier)
